description: S457 review: `lift` markup writes a call site's props onto the expanded component root, so a DECLARED prop `srcdoc=it.d` would write row data into an iframe document — refused at the write.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457) `srcdoc` in every form: "The refusal applies wherever such a write is emitted — including a component prop written onto an expanded component root". Before: `setAttribute("srcdoc", it.d)`, Chromium ran the data.
